overview: Role-based enablement, runbook walkthroughs, supervised exercises and formal handover to named customer staff. The scope is built around control register, legislative obligations and evidence sources, producing control evidence, gap register and audit-ready governance cycle. A customer-named compliance officer approves the work. The service-specific assurance focus is statutory sign-off and evidence preservation.

4) Acceptance: participant sign-off and completed tabletop simulation; verify statutory sign-off and evidence preservation.
5) Handover: runbooks, unresolved items, knowledge transfer and acceptance sign-off.
